name: Nil
source:
Tirs’ ex-boyfriend. He started studying Chemistry, but drop in the first year of Uni. Since then, he’s been chasing after his own dream of being a famous music and composer. He sings and plays in a goth romantic group and teaches music as a side job. He likes dressing elegantly and flirts without being aware, so he has many fans of both genders. He’s a really sweet person.

[From Casting Call]
